ta.p: Ta letter which is 24th letter in 41 letters, it is 16th in 33 Byaññaḥ,in  5-vagga it is being in the place of going (dantaja) ta-vagga and it (nissita)byaññaḥ- alphabet which depends on the first Sara of (dantaja)ta-vagga. Tipi,9,1 ta ta(ti) [tanu+kvi. Tara+kvi] (1) Thief, Robber. (2) The matter of stealing, Attack, Robbery. See - Takkara-(1). (3) Fox, Wild dog, Jackal. (4) Tails of animals (such as elephant, horse). See - Sūci. (5) Merit, Wholesome deed. See - Takkara-(2). (6) Stomach, Belly. See - Takkoṭaka. (7) Water. (8) Treasure. (A) Treasure such as pearl. (b) Treasure such as Buddha, Law and Sangha. (9) Lust. See -Tammaya-(1). Ta lāso(āguṃ)'ta'. Tipi,9,2 .Should be changed and chanted from another alphabet which is (ādesa=kāriya)'ta'. See origin. Tipi,9,2 ta ta khyera-kyecera-so(lopa)'ta'. Tipi,9,2+3 ta ta dhāta, liṅa-tiu့ noka- cīraṅa-sakarokace-apaso paccaññaḥphracaso 'ta'.  See original. Tipi,9,3+4 ta ta, noun (sabbanāma)'ta' which related with all gender.Tipi,9,4+5+6+7+8+9 ta ta saṅkhyā-ta. (This ta said  6-nos. saṅkhyā by the way of Piṭakasaṅkhyā). See also - Chappaccayadīpaka 88. Tipi,9,9 ta ta(pu) [tara+kvi] Ta sect from  chanaḥ treatise.
